headline: Enhance ClearInstall with Public Trend Signals
summary: Integrate real-time dependency analysis and risk assessment tools to improve the accuracy of ClearInstall's lockfile audit. Enhance user interface for better visibility into potential risks during npm/PyPI installations, including binding.gyp command expansion.
actions: Integrate Minireel/HGhub’s real-time dependency analysis capabilities to provide up-to-date security and vulnerability checks before installation.
Adopt janestreet/agent_skills to automate the risk assessment process, ensuring that ClearInstall can handle complex package dependencies more effectively.
